text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival has arrived.
The academy is overflowing with Umamusume fans...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Hey everyone, hope you have fun today♪
Our dance is gonna be amazing!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's play together a whole bunch!
And put big, bright smiles on our faces!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, the ones lined up over there...
It's the sisters, Narita Brian and Biwa Hayahide!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Sis, could you stay a bit further away?
We stand out too much when we're together..."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you implying that my 'hairstyle'
stands out... Is that what you're saying?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I didn't say that.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Her demeanor is so cool and sophisticated...!
She's so awesome~~...!!

Everyone is enjoying interacting with the fans.
Meanwhile, as for Nice Nature—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man... incredible.
Charm and glamour that'd put idols to shame.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the sparkling idol girls~.
No wonder the fans are head over heels.
choice_data_list: You should go mingle too, Nice Nature.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"I really, really want to, but...
after seeing something so sparkly... you know?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if an ordinary girl like me showed up,
it wouldn't really be much of a fan service, would it?
choice_data_list: We need to focus on gaining more fans right now, too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Right now... Wait, oh, right.
The Takarazuka Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
It's a fan-voted race, after all.
*sigh* Guess I really do have to put in the work...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, if it's just the usual me...
I'm kind of lacking that star power... Hmph, grrr."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well... maybe I should practice acting charming,
even if it's just going through the motions...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Wait, all I did was say it...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And so it begins! The 'Cuteness is Justice☆
Miss Beloved Umamusume Contest'~~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Your host is the Class Rep of Class Reps, yours truly, Sakura Bakushin O! Let's do this!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Naturally, eyes are on the surprise entry, Nice Nature!What kind of charm will she show us today?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Waaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Why did it turn out like this... Facebook!? (Wait, What on earth...!?)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wh...!
Curse you, Trainer, you betrayed me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Nature-san!
Let's see that charm of yours right away, please!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
What's that?!
You want the cheers to get even louder, is that it?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I did no such thing!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "We need help from all our fans!! Let's hear you get suuuuuper hyped up, everyoneee!!"

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
Do your best!
Nice Nature!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see Nature being charming!!
Do your best~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Guuughhh...! I-I can't get away...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Uuuuu~~...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —No way, I can't do thiiiis~!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, absolutely no way!
I don't have that sparkly charm in me...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
It's fine!
Ne-chan is adorable!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
Everyone from the shopping district...!?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
That's it, that's right!
You can take them on just as you always do!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Come on, sing your signature song!
Let's hear 'Passionate Flames: A Woman's Bitter Grudge'!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, that's straight-up enka!
It's way more soapy drama than sparkling romance!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Way to go, Nice Nature!
In the end, Nice Nature couldn't quite act charming, but she showed off the irresistible appeal of a beloved character nonetheless.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Agh, whatever happens, happens!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I... I am Nice Nature!
Aiming to marvelously become a mature woman☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Kyu... kyurururu~n!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Waaaahhhhh.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I-I know!
That was a close call, my bad!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Still, but, buttt~~...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Please, don't back away...

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
"...Whoaaaahhhhh!!
Nice Nature is just so cuuute!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh.

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text: Seeing you blush is the best! So cute~!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"You were fine, you were super cute!
Our idol, Nice Nature!!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: S-Stop it...! What is this? What is this!?

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
The first place in everyone's hearts goes to you,
Nice Nature!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!!
H-Hurry and save meee!

Seeing Nice Nature get so flustered got the whole
venue roaring with excitement.
She'd completely won over the crowd!
